decks: but this should only be drawn from once.

'In the shadows of our collective journey, I found myself ensnared in a dark forest of invisible threads. It is challenging to articulate how deep, silent, and omnipresent that forest was...' My memory falters when I try to recall last night, amidst the darkened depths of the forest, where spectral hands brushed against my own. Yet this dawn, my mind hums with fragments: PECUNIA SI UTI SCIS ANCILLA EST SI NESCIS DOMINA'

Under the oppressive canopy of our collective fear, I lost my way in a forest so silent it screamed. To convey the depth of that silence, the weight of the unseen terror it concealed, is a task that threatens to break my resolve. The chilling memory of last night within the forest's unlit labyrinth, where phantom whispers of the cannibalistic inhabitants clawed at my sanity, lingers like a specter. The rustling, the dreadful anticipation, the presence of a menace hidden in the shadows. This morning, my mind is an echo chamber of horror. Whispers of the unseen, terror of the forest-dwellers, dread of being the hunted prey in the dark forest.

'In the belly of the dark forest, I bore witness to an unspeakable act that shook the very core of my being. Hidden among the gnarled trees and thick undergrowth, primal violence unveiled its grotesque face. A woman, a victim, was violated by heartless savages, their grunts echoing in the haunting silence, their eyes reflecting the sinister glee of the act. The helplessness, the anger, the indignation. The revolting picture is etched deep within my consciousness, igniting a blaze of rage that refuses to die. Every time I close my eyes, I see her pain, hear her screams, and feel the beast of wrath clawing inside me, thirsting for justice.

As I journeyed deeper into the inky shadows, a figure emerged, bearing the unmistakable aura of authority. In the midst of the encompassing gloom, our eyes met... Last night, within the confines of the Dark Forest, I believe I encountered the spirit of a lawman, a chief perhaps, lost and wandering. The precise content of our conversation is lost to the twilight, a muffled echo amidst the tree trunks. Yet, an unspoken bond was formed in the silence. I am confident that we will recognize each other in the realm of the waking, connected by our shared nocturnal encounter

In the heart of the Endless Exchange, amidst the ceaseless ebb and flow of commerce, I chanced upon a token of real significance. It seemed to pulse in my hands, resonating with the relentless rhythm of the market. The energies of countless transactions, a pulsating drive for accumulation, infused this talisman of human desire. As I awoke, I carried with me the very essence of exchange, a tangible manifestation of the market's relentless heartbeat.

As I navigated through the Endless Exchange, I was surrounded by the frenzied dance of acquisition and transaction. Coins suspended from invisible strings, glinting enticingly, led the way for the mass of restless pursuers. Their eyes bore the desperation of a thirst unquenchable, their hands reaching out in ceaseless chase. But amidst this perpetual tumult, something else caught my eye - a symbol of value unlike the rest, a luminescent cryptocurrency that pulsed with an untamed energy. Unnoticed by the frantic multitude, it beckoned me down a path less traversed. Its glow led me through the maze of trade, promising a different understanding of value, a different rhythm of exchange. As I awoke, the luminous path remained etched into my memory, an imprint of my journey through the relentless marketplace.

The ceaseless chime of coin against coin reverberates throughout the Endless Exchange. Amidst the clamor of transactions and the frantic pursuit of riches, the Invisible Hand occasionally drops a nugget of insight, an accidental spillage in the fervor of commerce. As I navigated the tumultuous market last night, I found a unique token, the Gilded Paradox. Its surface was etched with intricate riddles, the lore of a forgotten trade, the secret lessons of the market. It bore the weight of an enigma that promised a wealth of understanding, far more valuable than any currency. It is said that the Invisible Hand guards secrets well, but in this moment, it had let slip a treasure. Yet, it's best not to draw the Hand's attention; after all, the market is ever-watchful.

The Endless Exchange is an arena of continuous transactions, a bustling marketplace with the clink of coins serving as its heartbeat. Amid the sea of figures, each with their own thirst for material gain, there are the select few who have risen to master the game. During a visit to the Exchange, I stumbled upon one such individual - a prosperous capitalist, draped in the aura of the Invisible Hand's favor. They were momentarily lost in the torrent of trade, ensnared by a problematic negotiation. With discretion and care, I helped them regain their footing. As they departed with a newfound appreciation, I knew our paths would cross again in the world of wakefulness. In the endless pursuit of wealth, it seems allies can be found in unexpected places.

As I wander deeper into the Wasteland of Want, the sky dims, eclipsed by thick, choking smog. The air grows heavy, laced with the metallic taste of iron and despair. Beyond a valley of skeletal machinery and desolate factories, I spot the ominous silhouette of a looming prison. In its shadow, gaunt figures toil away, each a specter of suffering. Their skin stretches taut over their protruding bones, their once vibrant life forces now nothing more than flickering sparks, growing dimmer with every passing second. Their movements are slow and laboured, the chains that bind them clinking mournfully with each feeble stir. A wave of profound despair washes over me. I realize that this place, this prison, is a refinery of human life, a monstrous apparatus that grinds the vitality out of these pitiful souls, reducing their existence to nothing more than raw, concentrated energy for the insatiable beast of greed. In the depths of this abhorrent vision, something stirs within me. An influence takes hold, icy and numbing. It is the invisible Hand of the Wasteland, its touch akin to a deathly cold shroud, the very embodiment of exploitation and unchecked greed. It is a harrowing memento of the monstrous power that unchecked desire can wield.

As I wander deeper into the Wasteland of Want, the sky dims, eclipsed by thick, choking smog. The air grows heavy, laced with the metallic taste of iron and despair. Beyond a valley of skeletal machinery and desolate factories, I spot the ominous silhouette of a looming prison. In its shadow, gaunt figures toil away, each a specter of suffering. Their skin stretches taut over their protruding bones, their once vibrant life forces now nothing more than flickering sparks, growing dimmer with every passing second. Their movements are slow and laboured, the chains that bind them clinking mournfully with each feeble stir. A wave of profound despair washes over me. I realize that this place, this prison, is a refinery of human life, a monstrous apparatus that grinds the vitality out of these pitiful souls, reducing their existence to nothing more than raw, concentrated energy for the insatiable beast of greed. In the depths of this abhorrent vision, something stirs within me. An influence takes hold, icy and numbing. It is the invisible Hand of the Wasteland, its touch akin to a deathly cold shroud, the very embodiment of exploitation and unchecked greed. It is a harrowing memento of the monstrous power that unchecked desire can wield.

In the immense void of the Wasteland of Want, you suddenly find yourself propelled into the chilling expanse of space. Surrounding you are the shattered remnants of once thriving planets, their crumbled fragments still echoing with the life they once harbored. The silent testament of civilizations extinguished, of worlds consumed in their entirety. As you float among these cosmic ruins, you reach out and touch a fragment. Through it, a wave of emotion floods you, the residual collective consciousness of an entire species. The terror of their final moments, the despair of knowing their world was ending, the pain of their struggle for survival. Yet, mixed in with this torrent of suffering, there's a strange sense of peace, an end to the constant toil and pain, a release from the fear and desperation. Drifting through the silent remains, you bear witness to the profound cost of unchecked exploitation, the ultimate price of greed. Yet you also experience the profound relief that comes with release from unending suffering, a poignant reminder of the complex tapestry of existence. This moment, both tragic and strangely serene, strengthens your resolve to prevent such a fate befalling your own world.

Within the tormented expanse of the Wasteland of Want, a figure emerged, bathed in an unholy light. With an offer draped in shadowy seduction, they beckoned me closer. 'Join us,' they whispered, their voice twining around promises of wealth, security, and a world under the Hand's golden reign. The temptation was potent, like a toxic brew. But behind their words lurked an insidious truth - a world stripped of choice, freedom chained, and souls bartered. A chill ran down my spine as I realized the true cost of their offer.

Deep within the Enchanted Forest, elegant felines move with ethereal grace. Their eyes shimmer with the rich hues of the forest, their minds echo with whispered wisdom. Their thoughts unfurl in my mind, every unspoken word resonating like a clear call in the stillness. Guided by their silent counsel, an image of their abode in the realm of wakefulness is etched into my consciousness.

'During our life's voyage, I found myself amidst a pathless forest, its darkness profound and overwhelming. The sheer wildness, the unyielding harshness, the thick impenetrability of the woods are ineffable...' Memories of the previous night remain hazy, where the shadows played tricks and ethereal wings brushed my skin in the spaces between the towering trees. This dawn, my mind buzzes with broken fragments: IN GI RUM IMUS NOC TE ET CON SUMI MUR IGNI RUM IMUS NOC TE ET CON SUMI MUR -'

The previous night saw me in the Forest, where unseen hands crafted shadows, and soft fur filled my senses. I felt a primal urge to succumb to my beastly instincts, to traverse on all fours and investigate the labyrinthine root network. Yet, the memory of my upright stature, my control over flame, iron, and language reigned me in. At the end, I discovered a secret shielded by Velvet, hidden under the mossy bark. The whispers of the bark under my fingertips now echo in written form..

Engulfed in the serenity of the Enchanted Forest, spectral figures float, their life's memories and passions intertwined with the very essence of the woods. Amidst the lilac blooms, under the cobalt glow, I stood at the core of a spectral congress. Despite the calm, a subtle wave of unease rippled through. The spirits, their form in a constant state of flux, met my gaze with restless eyes. Their tales, their unresolved desires stirred a restive undercurrent. Their disquietude resonated within me, their unvoiced stories striking a chord in my core..

'As I retreated to the profound depths, a figure manifested before me, their mouth sealed in eternal silence. In the vast expanse of nothingness, their appearance startled me...' I believe that last night, another soul and I shared the woods. The specifics of our exchange might evade my memory, yet I am certain of our impending recognition in the world of wakefulness.

Last night, within the Great Pavilion, a mysterious guide offered me a horn cup of dream-wine. 'The wine is imaginary,' she explained, 'but the cup is not. To navigate the Mansus, one must understand the distinction. Perhaps one day we'll journey together. Until then, let me share a secret -' and her breath stirred the silence.

Last night I visited the abode of the Enlightened Wanderer. My host, shrouded in an enigmatic air, offered me hidden truths. 'I bear the wisdom of countless lifetimes. Remember my teachings as you embark on your journey, and may they guide your path through the Mansus.'

I remember my dream vividly. The Pavilion, set against the infinite expanse of the Bounds, and its mistress, welcoming me with open arms. 'Many have come and gone,' she confessed, 'but the longing for companionship never fades. Here is a memento of our encounter.'

In last night's dream, I found myself in the Pavilion, where the mysterious guide posed a riddle without a question. 'How do we speak without voice? I did not enter through the ordinary gate. I made my own. Remember my words, for they carry the weight of the Mansus.'

In the enveloping blue of the Pavilion, I watched two phantom figures contend with swords of light. 'These specters were here long before me, remnants of the Mansus' ancient occupants. Their dance is entrancing, isn't it?'

Within the Pavilion, I met the Keeper of Shadows. With a knowing look, he unveiled the Mansus' hidden corners. 'Shadows can be friends or foes. Learn their secrets, and they might aid you against the hunters in your pursuit.'

Inside the Pavilion, I met the Patron of the Forgotten, a figure wrapped in dark intrigue. He held power and secrets in equal measure, hinting at a world unseen by many. 'The Mansus is more than meets the eye. Remember this and find your way in the dark.'

'The Mansus,' the Enlightened Wanderer once said, 'holds treasures beyond our grasp, but none more mesmerizing than the Orchard of Lights.' In my dream, I wandered the Orchard, its radiant fruit and peaceful mists a testament to the old Sun's glory.

Once, the Sun-in-Splendour walked the Orchard, filling it with his radiant brilliance. Now, his remnants wander the place, their silent footfalls a memory of his reign. Their distant presence is a gift of insight.

The Immortal Empress allows sleepers to stroll in the Orchard of Lights, where peace reigns supreme. Last night, I was among the privileged, and I woke up carrying a shard of its tranquility in my heart.

In the Orchard of Lights, every fruit is a secret, every bite an epiphany. The stories of the Mansus are etched in the bark of its luminous trees, and last night, I read a tale that still rings in my ears.

In the heart of the Orchard of Lights, beneath a tree that radiates pure light, the Holy Seer shares wisdom that stirs the soul. His words resonate with truth, infusing the tranquil surroundings with a profound spirituality.

Deep in the Orchard of Lights, a Radical Dreamer, a visionary, stirs up the serenity with fervor and fire. His passionate discourses spark a desire for change, even in this place of unchanging beauty, illuminating the radical potential that dreams can hold.

drawmessages.influenceheartg: Exploring the vibrancy of the Stag Door region, I stumble upon a beating, radiant influence of Heart. The hum of vitality and emotion reverberates through me. This influence is a lively symphony, a reminder of the powerful human connection, of the inherent worth in every individual, of the love and empathy that tie us all together.
drawmessages.influenceknocke: In sleep, I ran my fingers along the ridged edges of the Stag Door's scars. 'Our company it was that shattered it,' Ghirbi says suddenly. 'Before the Gods-who-were-flesh, the Mansus was forbidden to mortals. We were the first Know.' He begins again to weep his molten tears. 'I wish that we had not. I wish I had died in the world....' I have forgotten what else he said. But I remember the shape of the fissures in the Stag Door, and for all of today, doors will fear my touch.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriesc: Last night, Ghirbi was talkative. He spoke in his siege-engine voice of the histories he'd overheard in the waking world. I listened, until his stories tailed off again into weeping.
drawmessages.influenceforgec: Ghirbi was weeping again. I scooped up his molten tears in my cupped palm. In the dream, my skin peeled and blistered, but only in the dream.
drawmessages.year.stolen: As I wander the halls of The Pride, a peculiar sensation engulfs me. Amidst the vibrant murmurings of unity and the resonant echoes of connection, I stumble upon an anomaly. A year seems to have seeped into the very fabric of this place. A year imbued with shared laughter, shared tears, and profound unity. A year that once belonged to the flow of time, now firmly anchored in the heart of The Pride.

drawmessages.influencewinterg: As I traverse the sharp and biting path of the Ascent of Knives, I encounter a profound influence of Winter. Its bone-chilling stillness engulfs me. Like a silent, falling snow, it blankets all in a profound sense of peace and ending. The influence is a whispered eulogy, a solemn nod to the inevitable end and the beauty that lies within it.
drawmessages.influenceedgee: Of the place my dreams took me last night, this has been written: 'The ascent is glass. The walls are knives. Each step is blood.' I did not climb far. The pain was too great. When I woke, that pain remained with me - a pain I could employ to occult purposes, if I hurry.
drawmessages.influencegrailc: The Ascent of Knives is called the Sharp Stair, and the Mother of Mirrors, and the Feast of the Grail. If one is to look beneath the stair, as I did last night in my dreams, one understands that last name. It draws a tithe of blood from the feet of those who ascend. Empousai - some shaped like men, many shaped like women - wait beneath the glass of the stairs to satisfy their hunger. I did not approach; I made no sound; I only observed.
drawmessages.influencewintere: I visited the Ascent of Knives last night, that harshest of roads through the House. It has been sacred to the Meniscate and the Sun-in-Rags since the Intercalate, when the true Sun was divided. When I woke, my room was freezing. The chill of it had cracked the window-glass.
drawmessages.year.stolen: I traverse the chill winds and biting paths of the Ascent of Knives, a strange sense of timelessness pervades the air. Amidst the cutting iciness, a unique year seems to be embedded into the very glass of the stair. A year marked by silence, ending, and profound introspection. A year that was once a part of time's relentless march, now frozen in the bitter tranquility of the Ascent of Knives.

drawmessages.influencesecretg: Venturing along the swirling currents of the Painted River, I unearth a powerful influence of Secret Histories. The influence is like a hidden parchment, filled with encoded wisdom and ancient lore, waiting to be deciphered. It reminds me of the myriad stories concealed beneath the surface of our existence, of the veiled truths yet to be discovered.
drawmessages.fascination: I dreamt of the Mansus behind the White Door, of the great space above the Orchard, the space that overlooks the Bounds, the space where the Vagabond once painted her River. Painted ships passed upon the Painted River. I met the painted eyes of a painted captain. She saluted, and the motion was like the layered movement of clouds. The sail of the ship was amber and the captain's eyes the green of new barley and the river, aquamarine. Now that I'm awake, I see those colours still.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriesd: There is a great chamber in the Mansus through which a Painted River flows. The Vagabond, it is claimed, painted it from memory in the years before she left the House. Certainly there are histories concealed in its design. I traced them with my hand last night. There were fragments of aquamarine paint beneath my nails, flecks of gold leaf, when I was done.
drawmessages.eruditionplus: The Painted River runs from a great chamber near the White Door, far through the Mansus, to its far edge where it enters a painted delta of far cloud. I voyaged half its length last night with a stern-faced captain beneath a rust-red sail. As the clouds rose before us, the sailors raised a yearning shanty, and close-hauled the sails to best use the painted wind. And all the while the captain and I discoursed on the secrets of the House of the Sun....
drawmessages.year.stolen: Drifting along the Painted River, I encounter a strange anomaly. A year seems to have immersed itself into the river's vibrant strokes, becoming a part of its radiant tableau. It's a year filled with veiled revelations and half-whispered secrets, a year that has strayed from the linearity of time and found refuge in the swirling currents of the Painted River.

drawmessages.influentelanterng: Inside the ethereal glow of the Red Church, I discover a bright influence of Lantern. The influence is a radiant beacon, piercing the murkiness of ignorance with its illuminating glow. It's a call to enlightenment, a beckoning towards understanding and wisdom, and a testament to the power of knowledge.
drawmessages.influencegrailg: When one dreams of the Red Church, one hears the voices of the Grail's Names, the Thirstlies and the Ivories and the Lovelies and the rest. 'Not all the empousai are women,' they might be heard to say. 'The hungers of women run no deeper than the hungers of men. But a mother is never far from her child at its birth, and that is not always true of a father. Come closer, and we will show you what we mean.'
drawmessages.ingredientgraild: When I visited the Red Church last night, they told me, between their clawings and their caresses, that the Flowermaker had visited but lately, with his Nectar and his promise. I woke twined in sodden sheets, with the Amaranthine Nectar brimming in my hand. I captured what I could of it - only a few drops, but it will be enough.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriesf: I saw the Red Church again last night, with its pews of bone, the stained glass in shades of ruby, the golden altar that beats like a heart. That night the Names of the Grail gathered to speak of those Long who've sworn off the pleasures of the bedchamber - save between man and man, or woman and woman. 'They still pay the tribute of delight,' an Ivory said. 'They do not bear fruit,' a Lovely said. 'If Forge and Sun had only joined -' a Thirstly lamented. Then they fell to gossiping of the Long of the House of Lethe, and their deeds in the desert. I remember it still.
drawmessages.favour: Each of the stained glass windows of the Red Church is devoted to a distinct appetite, and the scenes they show are from life. Last night, in one of the uglier windows, I saw the appetites a certain public figure satisfied in private. I know he won't want this information made public. Perhaps he'll show me some consideration.
drawmessages.fascination: Last night I visited the Red Church, where the Grail conducts its feasts. The light through the stained glass windows was all the spectra of red and the Names of the Grail laboured to birth a new desire which had until today no name at all. I am sticky with the memory of it, and this morning everything I see is tinted ruby.
drawmessages.year.stolen: Within the vivid red confines of the Red Church, I feel a sudden shift in the rhythm of time. An entire year has insinuated itself into the crimson shades of this place. A year laden with insatiable appetites, desires taking shape, and the ecstatic pursuit of fulfilment. It's a year that has slipped from the calendar's grid, preferring to dwell amidst the Grail's indulgent feasts.

drawmessages.influencegrailg: Amidst the mesmerizing colors of the Peacock Door region, I find an alluring influence of Grail. The influence saturates the air with desire, pulsating with a lust for life that's as refreshing as it's intoxicating. It speaks of physical experiences, of the beauty of the senses, of the pleasure derived from fully immersing oneself in life's diverse banquet.
drawmessages.scholarvak: Last night I opened the Peacock Door, and afterwards it spoke to me. 'I am Vak,' it boasted, 'both the tongue and the Goddess. I am the only entrance into secret light. I was worshipped before you upright apes, and I will be still when all of you are ugly ash. Listen, and I will prove it.' I woke with my mouth full of words.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriese: Last night I opened the Peacock Door, and beyond it in the bright spaces of the House I met a pilgrim-adept. 'I am almost ready,' they said, 'to pass to the summit of the House, to prepare for the final ascent. Perhaps you'll join me. I will need allies, to fight for my place. Here is a story to help you rise.'
drawmessages.influencelanterng: Last night I satisfied the Peacock Door, and my action drew the attention of a certain Hour. In the golden spaces of the Mansus beyond I heard the Flowermaker's promise, and his promise is this: he cannot harm me, and he cannot find me, but if I will only come to him he will satisfy my desire as I satisfied the Peacock Door's. In earnest of this promise, my eyes have been opened, and this morning I see glory.
drawmessages.fascination: Beneath the gaze of the Peacock's Door, the world as I know it dissolves. Every detail, from the smallest grain to the grandest marvel, reveals a profound beauty, a symphony of interconnected magnificence. I stand at the threshold of the Red Church and the Worm Museum, as if poised on the edge of a dream. I witness the grandeur of existence from an overseer's vantage, and feel a rush of euphoria, a deep longing. The allure is overwhelming, resonating with an unnameable force that pulses through the Lambda Lambda Grail. I am left yearning for more, a potent fascination kindling within me.
drawmessages.year.stolen: Within the vibrant colors of the Peacock Door, a stolen year unveils itself. It's a year of passionate desires and enlightened knowledge, of unquenchable thirst for understanding and the radiant power of illumination. This year, dislodged from the confines of conventional time, chooses instead to bask in the allure of the Grail and the enlightening beacon of the Lantern.

decks.comment: This entry corresponds to the Peacock Door region in the Mansus. The aspects associated with this region are Lambda (Grail) and Lambda (Lantern).

drawmessages.influenceedgeg: Winding my way through the intricate mazes of the Worm Museum, I find a sharp influence of Edge. This influence is a honed blade, a symbol of overcoming and survival. It reminds me of the battles fought and victories won, of the spirit of resilience that enables us to face life's adversities head-on.
drawmessages.influencewinterg: Last night I visited the Worm Museum, which is both within the Mansus (for security) and without (for safety). The Hours have charged the Colonel with its defence, and even the Lionsmith does not challenge him here. Winter is the chiefest aspect of this place. The Worms thrive where things end, but they can also be ended, and they must, if the Mansus is to endure. This morning, the chilly certainty of the Colonel's hand still lies on my shoulder.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriesf: Size in the Mansus is negotiable, and so last night in the Worm Museum I saw one of the Worms who took Vienna, caged next to a Worm taken from the soul of a child. In dreams they are more visible than waking, smooth and dark as jewels. The walls bear stories of the First and Second Worm Wars. The Third is too recent to have passed into the Histories.
drawmessages.dread: I dreamt last night of the Worm Museum. The Hours have set wards about it and warnings before it, but they have left it open to mortal adepts who can prove themselves by reaching it. Perhaps they hope to inspire revulsion against the things that bred in the corpse of the Sun. Those things are here still, always dying, never dead. They came from Nowhere, the warnings say, and if they complete their work, the Mansus will be Nowhere, one day.
drawmessages.year.stolen: In the foreboding shadows of the Worm Museum, a stolen year takes form. This year speaks of persistence against the bitter chill of Winter and the relentless battles of Edge. A year where survival and resilience were honed, echoing the relentless struggle of existence against ending. Yet, as dire as the struggle may be, there is a whisper of strength, a promise of endurance. This stolen year is a testament to the perseverance of life in the face of oblivion.

decks.comment: This entry corresponds to the Worm Museum region in the Mansus. The aspects associated with this region are Sigma (Winter) and Theta (Edge).

drawmessages.influenceknockg: Last night I came to the Concursum, the crossroads of the Mansus, which has been called the Chamber of Ways. From here the Hours may pass to any place in the Mansus. Here the Horned-Axe spoke to me in her voice that is older than any living thing, and she said: there is a Door that will open for a little while. This is its time, and here is another division.
drawmessages.influencelanterne: Last night I came to the Concursum, the core of the Mansus, which has been called the Chamber of Revelations, whose mirrors are endless and whose paths all-encompassing. From here the Hours can see all that transpires in the Mansus. I saw the Watchman's light in the blue distance of the place, like a sun beneath the sea.
drawmessages.influencemothe: Last night I came to the Concursum, the Mansus-heart, which has been called the Chamber of Choices, where every path one does not take is a stillborn future. In the sea-sky blue of the Chamber's Light I saw the Sister-and-Witch pass, their four hands weaving two paths to one. I woke with my passions contorted to a knot. There's something I must do; there's always something I must do.
drawmessages.influencewintere: Last night I came to the Concursum, the place at which all the Mansus corridors end, which has been called the Chamber of Conclusions. Here the Hours meet in striving or execution or resignation. In the evening sapphire of the Chamber's light I saw the Sun-in-Rags pass with his shattered crown and his silent retinue, and this morning I woke shivering.
drawmessages.fragmentsecrethistoriesc: Last night I came to the Concursum, the Mansus-meridian, which has been called the Chamber of Histories. I spoke there with an adept long dead. She told me of her flight through the House, these dozen decades and more, of the ways in which the dead survive outside the Hours and recall the unsanctioned histories, and this morning I recall the ending of one of her stories.
drawmessages.fascination: Last night I came to the Concursum, the space at the centre of the Mansus, which has been called the Chamber of Mirrors. From here the Hours may pass to any place in the Mansus. I saw the Meniscate rise in the cobalt glory of the Chamber's light, dancer-lithe, moon-bright, and she reflected my face in her own and this morning that is all I can see.
drawmessages.year.stolen: In the manifold paths of the Concursum, a stolen year takes form. It is a year of choices unchosen and pathways untread, a year of reflections distorted in the mirrors of time. The year speaks of Winter's cold stillness, the moth's unerring change, and the lantern's piercing revelation. As I recall this year, I am reminded of the knock at the door, a promise of changes to come.

decks.comment: This entry corresponds to the Concursum region in the Mansus. The aspects associated with this region are Delta (Knock), Pi (Lantern), and Omicron (Moth).

decks: Last night in the Mansus I visited the Malleary, from whose engines and avenues one does not emerge unchanged. I watched the processes of sunset and I entered the amber joy and the white joy and the blue joy and I was subjected to the enlightenments of calcination and the Forge of Days touched me with her burnished fingers and I rise from my bed with the utter knowledge that all nights, all nights, all nights must end.

Last night in the Mansus I visited the Malleary, from whose hammers and crucibles one does not emerge unchanged, and for nine beats my heart ceased while it entered the fires of the Forge, and the passions of the Forge entered into it. I woke with the dawn, and its poor divided colours inspire memories of the Forge's passion for the Sun, of the Vagabond's curse, of the Grail's deep longing... so many half-memories.

Last night in the Mansus I visited the Malleary, from whose fires one does not emerge unchanged. The Forge's light fell upon me and my heart boiled and when I woke my blood burnt within me so that I had to shed it in a cup before it overwhelmed me
and lo, ten drops of it were not blood, exactly, unless it be the Blood of the Sun. Perhaps I found the cup and the blood is not mine. The Forge sears memory.

Last night in the Mansus I visited the Malleary, from whose impulses and rotations one does not emerge unchanged. There are many radiances there, from the fires and the Forge and her Names and her instruments, but one radiance lingers behind them all like a fading music: the last light of the Sun-in-Splendour, shed in the moments of his Division, here where the Forge is strongest. Now that I have awoken, I see that radiance still.

While traversing the labyrinthine pathways of the Chamber of Ways, I uncover a fluttering influence of Moth. The influence is an enigma, a promise of secrets and dreams yet to unfold. It speaks to the transformative power of change and the enticing allure of the elusive, inviting me to step into the shadows and discover the unknown.

The THIRST of the Spider's Door is second only to that of the Grail, or perhaps it's even the same thing. I passed it last night, but I penetrated no further into the Mansus. I spent an hour last night in a dream of its gullet, and this morning I am afire with avid appetites.

Last night I roamed the clustered organs of the Spider's Door. I found a node of particular vitality - all that remains of someone brave, or someone betrayed. While the THIRST of the Spider's Door was yet quiet, I brought it home in a fold of my soul.

The War of the Roads extended into the Mansus. In the corridors behind the Spider's Door, the mason-witch who styled himself Hubris Glamore has chronicled its skirmishes, in miles of lines of obsessive, branching memorial-script in the Mansus' dream-stone. Last night I traced it, reading of the campaigns of the Children of the Leashed Flame, the valiant defence of the Knot Sisterhood, the alliance with the Vagabond, the furious quarrels of the Grail and the Forge...

Last night behind the Spider's Door, I found an agent of order who had strayed into an unwise dream. The things that walk the Silken Sands, that greyness in which the Door is set, have an especial taste for policemen. He screamed until I freed him, but I did not free him until he had told me something useful...
